messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT ▸ Dedicated pool 'perseus-dedicated' canary slice error rate spike > 10% for 3m. Severity: P1. Auto-page oncall. https://redwood.internal/alerts/2487654321

kai: I’m seeing the alert. paging oncall.

ben (oncall-sre): oncall here — taking. joining call in 2m. which slice is affected?

kai: canary (10%) traffic only. errors are 5xx all from model runtime (KV cache miss causing OOM in some pods). logs attached below.

ben (oncall-sre): ok. immediate plan: 1) freeze canary artifact/promotions, 2) divert canary traffic -> stable variant (0%), 3) if needed, roll back pinned artifact. who can run artifact commands?

ashley: I can run the control plane steps. prepping commands.

ben (oncall-sre): handoff: kai -> ben. ben now owns mitigation. tagging runbook: #dedicated-canary-rollback.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook matched: Dedicated Canary Mitigation v2. Steps: artifact-freeze, traffic-divert, pod-eviction. Link: https://runbooks.internal/dedicated-canary-mitigation

maria: adding perf lead to call. I’ll monitor infra metrics and queues.

ben (oncall-sre): Ashley — please run artifact list for the pool and freeze promotions.

ashley: running:
```
redwoodctl artifacts list --pool perseus-dedicated --canary
# output -> artifact: perseus-art-2026-03-14 sha=abc123 def=bad
artifact: perseus-art-2026-03-07 sha=aa11bb prev-stable
```

ashley: freezing promotions:
```
redwoodctl artifacts freeze --pool perseus-dedicated --canary
# response: OK - promotions disabled
```

leo (perseus-cx): Perseus ops here. Confirmed impact on their internal QA and a handful of customers saw 502s. They’ve paused internal canary tests. Do not send external customer notice yet, please.

sophie (acct-mgr): noted. I’ll draft a short holding update for Perseus once we have a mitigation timeline.

ben (oncall-sre): next: divert canary traffic to stable variant (set canary percent -> 0). Ashley, can you run the traffic command?

ashley: running divert:
```
redwoodctl traffic update --pool perseus-dedicated --canary-percent 0 --to stable
# response: traffic update accepted -> canary 0% stable 100%
```

deploy-bot: ACTION TAKEN: Traffic slice update completed by ashley. Change id: ch_0f7a9.

ben (oncall-sre): evict offending pods to clear KV cache and restart-serving path. Maria, kick a rolling restart of the canary nodegroup? We want fresh pods but no traffic.

maria: kicking restart now: `k run restart --selector=perseus-dedicated-canary --rolling`

kai: logs (excerpt):
```
[2026-03-14T18:12:02Z] ERROR runtime: kv cache OOM at 0x7ff.. - attempt alloc 2.1G
[2026-03-14T18:12:03Z] WARN request: retrying model init for session 0x9a3
[2026-03-14T18:12:04Z] ERROR http: 502 writing response
```

ben (oncall-sre): likely regression in the canary artifact `perseus-art-2026-03-14` (sha=abc123). We should pin the pool to previous stable artifact while we investigate. Ashley can you pin to `aa11bb`?

ashley: pinning:
```
redwoodctl artifacts pin --pool perseus-dedicated --artifact aa11bb --reason "emergency mitigation - revert canary causing OOM"
# OK: pool pinned to aa11bb
```

deploy-bot: DEPLOYMENT ACTION: pool perseus-dedicated pinned to artifact aa11bb by ashley.

leo (perseus-cx): confirm — once pin is effective we can resume their QA and I’ll coordinate a short status message internally.

ben (oncall-sre): monitoring. Maria — can you watch for errors dropping and latency normalization?

maria: metrics look good so far. error rate dropped from 12% -> 0.8% in last 2 mins. latency back to baseline. I’ll keep a 15m watch.

sophie (acct-mgr): Draft for Perseus (internal): "We detected increased errors on your dedicated canary slice. We have frozen promotions, diverted traffic to stable, and pinned your pool to the previous artifact. We will update in 30 minutes with status." Want to send?

leo (perseus-cx): send to internal ops only for now. hold external incident until we confirm stability 30m.

ben (oncall-sre): agreed. Keeping external comms blocked until post-stability.

kai: quick note — we should capture the offending artifact and branch to a debug instance for introspection. Assign to eng-ml.

ashley: tagging eng-ml and creating debug job: `redwoodctl debug create --artifact abc123 --pool debug-perseus --notes "OOM repro"`

ops-runbook-bot: Recommended follow-ups: create postmortem, notify CS/L4, schedule rollback retro if artifact issue confirmed.

ben (oncall-sre): handoff in 10m to maria for monitoring window and root-cause tracking. ben out after 10.

maria: taking over monitoring. I’ll also coordinate with eng-ml on the debug repro.

sophie (acct-mgr): internal note created: INC-2487654321 - Perseus canary artifact freeze. I’ll standby for customer comms.

leo (perseus-cx): thanks everyone. appreciate the quick action.

ben (oncall-sre): closing immediate mitigation: traffic diverted, pool pinned, pods restarted. Continue watch. If errors reappear -> escalate to P0 and re-open.

maria: 15m monitor started. will post summary at `+30m` and escalate if anything.

incident-bot: ALERT UPDATE: Incident mode -> mitigated. State: watch. Next update scheduled: +30m.

sophie (acct-mgr): assigned follow-ups: (1) postmortem owner needed (suggest @ashley), (2) customer update at +30m if stable.

ashley: I’ll own the postmortem and coord with eng-ml for root cause.

leo (perseus-cx): ping me when postmortem draft ready. We’ll want to review before external comms.

maria: last note — observed a small spike in memory on two nodes prior to OOM; attaching monitoring graph to the ticket.

ben (oncall-sre): thanks team. handing off. I’m clear.

maria: 30m status: metrics stable, no errors for 28m. will keep watch 2 more hours. preparing timeline for postmortem.

sophie (acct-mgr): sending internal update to Perseus ops now per request.

leo (perseus-cx): received. thanks.
